description: The RLTP reading of the Trust Tasks TF shared proof vectors in this directory (copied unchanged from trustoverip/dtgwg-trust-tasks-tf, fixtures/proof/, at the commit below). Per file: the TF's expectation (as its manifest.json states it), whether the signature holds under its own cryptosuite without any profile gate (eddsa-jcs-2022, or ecdsa-jcs-2019 over P-256 or P-384), and what an RLTP verifier answers with the rule that decides it. Checked by conformance/tf-proof-vectors.mjs in npm run validate.

source.framework: Trust Tasks framework, Working Draft 0.7.0 (SPEC.md at that commit)
